headline: Kai, consumer inflation behaved yesterday — at 8:30 we find out whether producers did too.
subline: PPI consensus sits at 4.9 percent after a tame CPI tilted Fed bets toward a hold, Brent pauses below $89 on Hormuz deal talk, and Applied Materials reports after the close.
asof: Pre-market · as of 6:55 AM ET · every figure links to its source below

items.title: Tame July CPI tilts Fed bets toward a hold
items.sentence: Consumer prices rose 0.1% in July for a 3.4% annual rate, matching expectations, and traders tilted toward the Fed holding after a roughly 50-50 split the day before, per Yahoo Finance.

items.title: Producer prices at 8:30, consensus 4.9 percent
items.sentence: XTB's calendar puts July PPI consensus at +0.2% on the month and 4.9% on the year, down from 5.5%, with core easing to 4.2%.

items.title: Claims, a 30-year auction and Barkin fill the tape
items.sentence: Investing.com pencils in 202,000 initial claims versus 199,000 prior, plus a 30-year bond auction after a 5.058% prior stop and Richmond Fed's Barkin at 8:40 AM.

items.title: AI infrastructure earnings keep doing the lifting
items.sentence: Super Micro and CoreWeave each jumped about 19% after results, per Investing.com, extending the upbeat tech-earnings run that has carried the week.

items.title: JD.com before the open, Applied Materials after
items.sentence: Trader Alex Desjardins' calendar on X has JD.com premarket and Applied Materials after the bell, with no voting Fed speakers scheduled.

items.title: Trump claims Hormuz control; Pakistan sees deal forming
items.sentence: Trump called the US blockade 'infallible' while Pakistan's defense minister said things are shaping up 'in favor of a peace arrangement or a deal,' per CBS News.

items.title: Iran hardens military posture as talks sit frozen
items.sentence: Bloomberg reports Tehran is taking a more aggressive military stance with US talks frozen.

items.title: Houthi missiles kill six on Red Sea cargo ship
items.sentence: Just Security's digest says three ballistic missiles struck the vessel, killing four crew members and two rescuers; the Houthis claimed it carried Saudi military equipment.

items.title: Judge blocks mail-in voting order in all states
items.sentence: A federal judge expanded the injunction against Trump's mail-in voting executive order nationwide ahead of the November 3 midterms, per Just Security.

items.title: Ukraine hands Washington its proposals to end the war
items.sentence: Zelenskyy says Kyiv submitted war-ending proposals to US negotiators, per Just Security, after Vice President Vance asked Ukraine to halt strikes on non-Russian tankers.

items.title: Anthropic courts IPO investors for an October listing
items.sentence: TheStreet reports a confidential S-1 filed June 1, Morgan Stanley, Goldman and JPMorgan leading, and a $965 billion post-money valuation from May's Series H.

items.title: Gemini passes 1 billion monthly users
items.sentence: Forbes reports Gemini became Google's fastest-growing product ever after crossing 1 billion monthly users.

items.title: IBM to build Together AI a Blackwell cluster
items.sentence: The $240 million multiyear deal covers roughly 2,000 Nvidia Blackwell chips in a US-based inference cluster, per Tech Startups.

items.title: Nvidia readies Nemotron 4 at a trillion parameters
items.sentence: Tech Startups says the next generation of Nvidia's open models targets roughly one trillion parameters.

items.title: AI agents ran a cyberattack on Taiwan nuclear plant
items.sentence: Tech Startups reports the China-linked operation used AI agents that conducted reconnaissance and attempted break-ins simultaneously.
